why: The race card in ¶191 names Mr. Heath Newton as owner of The Negro.
The race card names Colonel Wardlaw as owner of Pugilist.
The race card names the Duke of Balmoral as owner of Iris.

Pugilist is listed as entry 2 on the race card.
Iris is listed as entry 5 on the race card.
Rasper is listed as entry 6 on the race card.

¶183-191 describe arriving at Winchester for the Wessex Cup race, four days later.
